newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Gold Fields says probing Leeudoorn options.
newsitem.headline: Gold Fields says probing Leeudoorn options.

text.p: Gold Fields of South Africa Ltd said on Thursday it was investigating alternative options for the Leeudoorn division of Kloof Gold Mining Co Ltd which was already well advanced.
The Leeudoorn division reported a second quarter loss of 29.34 million rand from the 5.64 million rand loss in the three months to end March 1997.

Gold Fields said in a statement that a major increase in unit working costs to 65,909 rand/kg from 55,020 rand and a drop in gold output to 1,769 kg from 1,892 kg were the prime factors behind the increased loss.
"Investigations into the alternative options for this division are well advanced which could lead to substantial changes.
"In the interim, efforts to increase the tonnage milled will continue and the current yield is expected to be maintained," the company said.
